compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
### 1. Technical Environment

* **code_version:** 7f406df621ffc97beb36c31c62368aaf2c21f08d
* **Context Scope:** plugins/dso/scripts/migrate-design-notes-to-design-md.sh; invoked from skill Migration Check blocks (e.g. fix-bug SKILL.md)

### 2. Incident Overview

* **Scenario Type:** User-Flagged Behavior

#### Expected Behavior

The idempotent migration (design-notes.md -> DESIGN.md) should either (a) commit/stage its own migration output atomically, or (b) be a clean no-op once migrated, so it never leaves dangling uncommitted changes in a contributor's worktree. A migration run as a side effect of an unrelated skill (fix-bug Migration Check) must not pollute that session's working tree.

#### Actual Behavior

Running the skill Migration Check during a /dso:fix-bug session executed migrate-design-notes-to-design-md.sh, which modified .claude/design-notes.md (replaced with a DEPRECATED stub) and created an untracked DESIGN.md at repo root. These changes were left uncommitted and unmerged in the worktree, surfacing in 'git status' alongside the unrelated bug fix and at risk of being swept into the wrong commit. The migration does not commit/merge the migrated files itself.

### 5. Skills and Workflows

Surfaced during the fix-bug session for bug 5ec9-5f36-9851-42e9. Filed at user's explicit request.

comments.body: Investigation: ROOT_CAUSE confirmed. migrate-design-notes-to-design-md.sh writes DESIGN.md + tombstones .claude/design-notes.md but has zero git operations. All 7 calling Migration Check blocks (fix-bug, debug-everything, brainstorm, sprint, roadmap, preplanning, onboarding SKILL.md) run it via `bash $PLUGIN_SCRIPTS/migrate-design-notes-to-design-md.sh 2>/dev/null || true` with no staging/committing afterward. Fix: add git add + git commit (plain, no --no-verify) for the two affected files at the end of the migration path, wrapped in || true for silent-fail in restricted contexts.
